note: Sequoia NF campground in oak woodland on the north-west shore of Lake Isabella beside Hwy 155, 6 mi north of the town of Lake Isabella; a marina and boat ramps are just south. Overhanging branches can scrape taller RVs, and summer highs reach the 100s. The dump station was out of service in November 2026. Run by the concessionaire ExplorUS. --Claude
summary: Tillie Creek (Sequoia NF, Lake Isabella): lakeview kept (lakefront lead on the east loop); $36, $8 extra vehicle; non-site-specific reservations, 14-night limit; season per recreation.gov Jan 1-Oct 24 (FS says Apr-Oct, flagged); 159 sites, max 40 ft (FS 45); pin ~960 m off on a neighbouring mobile-home park.
